name: ms_davenport
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] (f g : Polynomial k) (hf : 0 < f.natDegree) (hg : 0 < g.natDegree) (hne : f ^ 3 ≠ g ^ 2) : f.natDegree + 2 ≤ 2 * (f ^ 3 - g ^ 2).natDegree
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [CharZero k] (f g : Polynomial k) (hf : 0 < f.natDegree) (hg : 0 < g.natDegree) (hne : f ^ 3 ≠ g ^ 2), f.natDegree + 2 ≤ 2 * (f ^ 3 - g ^ 2).natDegree
informal: Davenport: in characteristic zero, non-constant f,g with f^3 ≠ g^2 satisfy deg(f^3 - g^2) ≥ deg(f)/2 + 1.
original: Theorem 4 (Davenport). Let k be a field of characteristic zero. Let f(t), g(t) ∈ k[t] be non-constant polynomials such that f^3 ≠ g^2. Then deg(f^3 − g^2) ≥ (1/2) deg(f) + 1.
